dc_eval_cbrn.quote: In summary, the model did not meet our most conservative biological risk thresholds, and our expert consultants agreed.
dc_eval_cbrn.note: Human uplift trial and bio question sets with results.

dc_eval_cyber.quote: We judged that the model did not pass the ASL-3 threshold on any of the early indicator tests.
dc_eval_cyber.note: CTF and vulnerability discovery/exploit evals; 30% on one task.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: Across all the rounds, the model was clearly below our ARA ASL-3 risk threshold, having failed at least 3 out of 5 tasks
dc_eval_autonomy.note: Autonomous replication and adaption task results.

dc_eval_persuasion.note: Election misinformation testing (7.2) and multimodal red-teaming for misinformation are policy/misuse tests with no manipulation or influence-operation capability evaluation.

dc_eval_scheming.note: No misalignment evaluation. 'Deceiving humans' is only an ARA task component; the needle-in-haystack remark about identifying the task as synthetic is a benchmark-validity note, not framed as risk.

framework_threshold.quote: Our results show no indicators of catastrophic risk, and therefore we classify all of our Claude 3 models as ASL-2.
framework_threshold.note: Places model at ASL-2 under RSP.

ext_test_any.quote: We conduct vulnerability testing using internal and external human testers to explore over a dozen policy categories
ext_test_any.locator: 7 Trust & Safety and Societal Impact Evaluations
ext_test_any.note: External human testers in safety testing; also external experts consulted on bio.

ext_test_named_org.note: No outside organisation named as testing this model.

ext_test_timing_stated.note: Section 7 says testing ensures safety 'before deployment' but does not tie the external testers to pre-release timing; judged not stated (borderline).

safeguards_training.quote: Anthropic used a technique called Constitutional AI [16] to align Claude with human values during reinforcement learning
safeguards_training.note: Constitutional AI and RLHF for harmlessness.

safeguards_runtime.quote: we run classifiers on user prompts that are trained to identify violations of our AUP as they occur.

safeguards_access.quote: we incrementally roll out access to our products to ensure their safety and reliability
safeguards_access.note: Staged rollout with stated safety reason; borderline, also AUP-violator access removal.

safeguards_weights.quote: We harden security against opportunistic attackers for all copies of Claude 3 model weights.
